_readme: Configured sources only poll public value pages. See README for source coverage and robots.txt restrictions. `ignore_robots` skips the robots.txt check for that one source and must only be set when the site's operator has given permission.

elvebredd._permission: Owner states Elvebredd's operator gave them permission to read values. Its robots.txt disallows /api and the calculator path, so the robots check is skipped for this source only. Set ignore_robots to false or enabled to false to stop.
elvebredd._note: Reads rvalue/nvalue/mvalue (regular/neon/mega) from the page's embedded Next.js payload. Only one real fragment has been seen, so verify with `python -m adoptme ingest`. Unit differs from Adopt Me Values (Bat Dragon 1001 here vs 3.15 Frost there); sources are stored separately.

adoptmevalues._note: Reads the embedded pet list and its variant values in Frost units.
